Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class VoicerEvent< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a Voicer UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use VoicerEvent<void> or VoicerEvent<> if there's no owner.

See also:
Voicer , VoicerEvent<void>
